meta.title: GnomeVPN server status
meta.description: Whether GnomeVPN servers are working right now, which protocols each one offers and how much of the last 30 days it was available. Check whether your traffic goes through the VPN.

title: Server status
intro: We check every server once a minute. Here you can see whether it is working right now, which protocols it offers and how much of the last 30 days it was available.

nodes.title: Servers
nodes.unavailable: Could not load the server status.
nodes.empty: No server is in service right now — check back a little later.
nodes.uptime: {percent} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
nodes.note: A server counts as available when it answers the check and its tunnel is on. “Having problems” means the latest check failed or the server is overloaded; “Unavailable” means it has not answered for several minutes in a row. Days are counted in UTC; an empty bar is a day the server was not checked yet.

check.title: Check your connection
check.body: Find out whether this browser’s traffic goes through GnomeVPN. When you press the button, the browser asks the ipify service for its IP address and we compare it with the addresses of our servers. The address is not stored anywhere.
check.notVia: Your traffic is not going through GnomeVPN right now
check.notViaHint: Turn the VPN on in the app and check again.
check.failed: Could not check the connection. The browser or an ad blocker may have blocked the request to ipify — try again.
